rectForNote: ONE RECT CANNOT SERVE EVERY FRAME, and this is why the two heads survived a rect fix. The coach's door-open frame is a SEPARATE GENERATION, not the same picture with a door swapped: it differs from the plain idle on 162,227 pixels across the whole 956x389 canvas, and its driver sits twelve pixels right and nine up. Matching the neutral overlay into each frame by cross-correlation: idle x409 y10 at 0.873, idle/door-open x421 y1 at 0.908, walk x409 y10 at 0.892. The door is open for the whole of beats 2 to 6 -- the entire conversation -- so the overlay drew at the shut-door position over open-door art for every frame that matters, which is two heads side by side.
